prayerExcerpt.en-US: The proof of love is in the works.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A prova do amor está nas obras.

meta.face: A mature man around 55, bald on the crown and high forehead, the hair at the sides worn long and neatly curled, a moderate tawny reddish-gold beard, slim slightly aquiline nose, well-formed chin, serene expression.
meta.basis: John the Deacon's description of the portrait painted just after Gregory's death.

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
